relevant_laws.quote: Where the signal is a green straight-through arrow alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed straight through, but must not turn right or left. Such vehicular traffic must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and to pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk at the time the signal is exhibited.
relevant_laws.notes: Sole straight-through arrow at frozen intersection; original signal pixels and lawful-user facts remain unobserved.
